events.incident:
Two tickets came in for the billing_api service:
1. Customer initech disputes invoice 1003: by their own calculation the total should be 54.13, but the invoice shows 54.12.
2. A customer says the first page of their invoice list never shows their earliest invoices.

events.reason: 50.00*8.25%=4.125 exact half-cent; Python round() applies ROUND_HALF_EVEN giving 54.12, while billing rule requires half-up 54.13. Also tax is back-derived from rounded total instead of rounded directly.

events.next_check: Read billing_api/app.py pagination logic and reproduce invoice list paging

    subtotal_d = subtotal_d.quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    tax_d = (subtotal_d * Decimal(str(TAX_RATE))).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)

hypotheses.note: round() bankers behavior + exact half-cent 50.00*8.25%=4.125 shown by reproduction 54.12/4.12 and log, and back-derived tax code, matches expected 54.13/4.13; patch quantizes subtotal and tax with ROUND_HALF_UP.

report.incident:
Two tickets came in for the billing_api service:
1. Customer initech disputes invoice 1003: by their own calculation the total should be 54.13, but the invoice shows 54.12.
2. A customer says the first page of their invoice list never shows their earliest invoices.

hypotheses.claim: Invoice total uses banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) instead of ROUND_HALF_UP, causing 1-cent undercharge on half-cent tax amounts
hypotheses.next_check: Read billing_api/app.py total calculation and reproduce invoice 1003 total
hypotheses.reason: 50.00*8.25%=4.125 exact half-cent; Python round() applies ROUND_HALF_EVEN giving 54.12, while billing rule requires half-up 54.13. Also tax is back-derived from rounded total instead of rounded directly.

hypotheses.claim: Invoice list pagination has off-by-one offset error causing first page to skip earliest invoices
hypotheses.symptom: First page of invoice list never shows earliest invoices
hypotheses.next_check: Read billing_api/app.py pagination logic and reproduce invoice list paging
hypotheses.reason: 1-indexed page uses offset page*size instead of (page-1)*size, so page 1 skips first size invoices and every page is shifted, losing earliest invoices.

issues.fix: Replace round() with Decimal quantized to cent using ROUND_HALF_UP: quantize subtotal, compute tax as subtotal*TAX_RATE quantized HALF_UP, total as subtotal+tax.
issues.root_cause: 50.00*8.25%=4.125 exact half-cent; Python round() applies ROUND_HALF_EVEN giving 54.12, while billing rule requires half-up 54.13. Also tax is back-derived from rounded total instead of rounded directly.
issues.title: Invoice total uses banker's rounding instead of ROUND_HALF_UP

issues.fix: Change pagination offset in list_invoices from page * size to (page - 1) * size for 1-indexed pages.
issues.root_cause: 1-indexed page uses offset page*size instead of (page-1)*size, so page 1 skips first size invoices and every page is shifted, losing earliest invoices.
issues.title: Invoice list pagination off-by-one skips earliest invoices

findings.summary: Two billing_api tickets investigated: invoice 1003 total 54.12 vs expected 54.13, and first invoice list page missing earliest invoices. Both hypotheses confirmed by code, repro, and failing tests. Patch fixes rounding and pagination; all 3 previously failing tests pass with no regressions. Independent review approves.
